Rebuild with 04_tools/20_fetch_product_ranges.py. 'epd_scope' is what each 2024 declaration covers (brands, thicknesses, plants), read from the EPDs themselves; match a collection to it by brand and then thickness. No range asserts an EPD id, because brand plus thickness does not always give a single answer.

EPDITALY0178.excludes: Series produced on the 'piastrelle in ceramica' (pressed tile) line.
EPDITALY0178.note: Scope, verbatim: 'lastra in gres porcellanato media tra i diversi prodotti di Emilceramica S.r.l. realizzati nel sito di Fiorano, ad esclusione delle serie realizzate con la tecnologia della linea produttiva "piastrelle in ceramica"'. A collection therefore qualifies only if it is made at Fiorano AND on the slab line; tile formats are out by definition. Declares no brand and no series. EXPIRED 08/04/2026.
